Kitchens & Bathrooms

Heart of the home

Kitchens and bathrooms are the heart and soul of any home—the places where we start our days and gather with loved ones. We blend ergonomic design, modern layouts, and high-end materials to create environments that are both highly functional and visually stunning. Our transformations are designed to provide a daily experience of luxury and comfort.

In the kitchen, we focus on creating a chef-inspired workspace with custom cabinetry, premium stone countertops like granite or dolomite, and professional-grade appliance integration. Whether it's a massive island for entertaining or a hidden pantry for organization, every detail is tailored to your culinary needs.

For bathrooms, we create spa-like retreats that offer a sanctuary from the outside world. From oversized glass-enclosed showers and custom vanities to intricate tile work and designer fixtures, we prioritize both aesthetics and durability. We use high-performance materials that stand up to the Florida humidity while maintaining a timeless, elegant appearance.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does kitchen or bathroom remodeling cost?

Cost depends on room size, layout changes, material selections, building-system work, and existing conditions. An accurate estimate requires a defined scope and site evaluation.

How long does a kitchen or bathroom remodel take?

The schedule depends on scope, permits, material lead times, inspections, and unforeseen existing conditions. A project-specific timeline is established during planning.

Do kitchen and bathroom remodels require permits in Tampa Bay?

Kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects that involve plumbing relocation, electrical work, or structural changes require permits from the applicable local authority. Cosmetic-only updates — such as cabinet refacing or painting — typically do not. Unique Building Contractors evaluates permit requirements during the planning phase and manages all applicable permits and inspections as the contractor of record.

Do you install cabinets and countertops?

Yes. The listed kitchen services include custom cabinetry design and installation, and granite, quartz, and dolomite countertop installation coordinated with backsplash and fixture selections.

Do you install walk-in or glass showers?

Yes. The bathroom remodeling scope can include frameless glass-enclosed showers, custom tile work, curbless entry designs, vanities, and fixtures based on the approved design.

Can you change the kitchen or bathroom layout?

Yes, when site conditions and the approved structural, plumbing, and electrical scope support the change. Layout modifications are evaluated during the planning phase before construction begins.
